issues.display_title: Issue #87: feat(auth/me): expose has_password field to support change-password UX
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 17/07/26

✅ Implementation: Auth Me Has Password Implementation

Scope

Adds a has_password boolean to GET /v1/auth/me so the frontend can choose the correct change-password UX.

Controller Response

File: src/controllers/v1/auth/me.go

  • Added has_password to the returned user profile.
  • Value is computed from whether the stored password hash is present:
"has_password": user.Password != "",
  • Email-registered accounts return true.
  • Google OAuth accounts without an email password return false.
  • Password hash remains excluded from the response.

Tests

File: src/controllers/v1/auth/me_test.go

  • Covers password account returning has_password: true.
  • Covers Google-style account with empty password returning has_password: false.
  • Asserts the response does not expose a password field.
  • Covers unauthorized response when no authenticated user is present.

Verification

Passed:

go test ./src/controllers/v1/auth -count=1

Full suite note:

go test ./... -count=1

Context

Frontend needs to detect whether a logged-in user has a password set (i.e. was registered via email) or not (Google OAuth account with no password hash).

This is required for the change-password flow on the profile page (see gothru-3d-floormap#256):

  • Email account → show "Old password" field
  • Google account → hide "Old password" field, show note: "Your account uses Google sign-in. Enter a new password to add email login."

Currently GET /v1/auth/me does not expose whether the user has a password. The password field is (correctly) never returned, so the frontend has no signal.

Change Required

In src/controllers/v1/auth/me.go, add has_password to the response:

"has_password": user.Password != "",

Full updated response block:

return helpers.FormatResponse(c, 200, fiber.Map{
    "message": "user profile retrieved",
    "user": fiber.Map{
        "created_at":     user.CreatedAt,
        "updated_at":     user.UpdatedAt,
        "name":           user.Name,
        "email":          user.Email,
        "avatar":         user.Avatar,
        "email_verified": user.EmailVerified,
        "has_password":   user.Password != "",
    },
}, startTime)

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /v1/auth/me returns has_password: true for email-registered accounts
  • GET /v1/auth/me returns has_password: false for Google OAuth accounts
  • No password hash or any password data is ever exposed in the response
